Daniel insists that no old phrase and no deleted exact minute should leak back in, reinforcing that deleted phrases and removed exact times must not reappear in any backup-signer notes. More broadly, Daniel states that nothing deleted in the household coordination chain should be restated later under pressure; Elise Holt has recorded this as a standing instruction applying to the whole Rowan cluster.
